# MyIcons

MyIcons is a React icon library for payment methods, banks, wallets, cards, and digital payment platforms.

The library provides reusable React icons designed for developers building web applications with React and TypeScript.

## Documentation

- [MyIcons](https://myicons.vercel.app/): Main website and library overview.
- [Icons](https://myicons.vercel.app/icons/): Browse all available icons.
- [Contribute](https://myicons.vercel.app/contribute/): Information about contributing icons to MyIcons.

## Icon Pages

Individual icon documentation is available through the [Icons](https://myicons.vercel.app/icons/) page.

Each icon page provides the icon name, category, preview, and React usage information.

## Usage

MyIcons provides React components that can be imported and used in React applications.

## Categories

Icons are organized into categories including:

- Banks
- Payment methods
- Digital wallets
- Cards
- Other financial and payment platforms
